patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance and Facebook app events, and stops the advertising ID from being collected.

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Hides promoted answers, sponsored posts and Google ads in the feed and on question pages, and blocks requests to ad servers.
